thread:
maggie: quick sync — I ran a small profile on the 8xA100 TPP config with the new kernel selector patch, and KV cache lookups spiked CPU wait times. attaching notes.
ryan: can you paste the flamegraph link? curious if the all-reduce is impacted or it's pure KV hotpath contention.
maggie: perf-bot uploaded: https://perf.internal/graphs/1857501234/kv-affinity.svg
maggie: TL;DR — read latency median up ~12%, p95 up ~22% after selector change. compute utilization steady, but NVLink stalls increased.
deepa: did you isolate TP vs PP placement? my hunch: KV shards moved across tensor ranks and broke locality for the new batched lookup path.
maggie: yes. I tested three placements: (1) TP-aligned shards (kv on tensor peers), (2) PP-aligned shards (kv on pipeline stages), (3) naive round-robin (current). numbers below.
ryan: share the numbers pls
maggie: results:
- TP-aligned: median latency 48ms, p95 83ms, all-reduce waiting ~7% CPU idle
- PP-aligned: median 52ms, p95 90ms, all-reduce waiting ~12%
- round-robin: median 54ms, p95 102ms, all-reduce waiting ~18%
maggie: so TP-aligned wins for our microbenchmarks. also batching behavior changed: the new kernel selector favors fused gather kernels which assume contiguous shard layout.
sasha: that matches my earlier sim: fused kernels expect same-device KV chunks to avoid NVLink hops. if shards are distributed across pipeline ranks we get cross-stage NVLink + PCIe hops and larger tail.
deepa: can we change the selector to prefer fused gather only when shard affinity score >= 0.8? otherwise fall back to scatter-gather that tolerates nonlocal shards.
ryan: what's the cost of scatter-gather? more memory copies and compute, right? any regression numbers?
maggie: scatter-gather median +6ms but p95 improves in PP cases vs fused when nonlocal. so safe fallback.
perf-bot: profiling summary attached:
```
cmd: ./bench_kvcache --model=gpt-xl --layout=8x1_tp_pp --selector=v2
samples: 5000
metrics:
  median_latency_ms: 48
  p95_latency_ms: 83
  allreduce_wait_pct: 7
  nvlink_hop_count_avg: 1.2
```
maggie: propose heuristic change:
1) compute shard_affinity score = fraction of requests that hit local KV index within same tensor rank over last 5m
2) if affinity >= 0.8 -> enable fused gather / kernel-selector=v2
3) if affinity < 0.8 and affinity >= 0.4 -> enable hybrid mode: batch local fused, scatter for remote
4) else -> fallback scatter-gather kernel
sasha: +1 but need to ensure we collect affinity cheaply. maybe piggyback on existing prefix cache metrics and add a small sampled probe (1% of requests) that logs locality bit.
deepa: also add a config knob to pin shard layout per-job: some customers prefer PP for memory isolation. we should expose a force_layout: [tp,pp,round_robin]
ryan: can we simulate impact on throughput? if fused reduces per-token CPU by X, it might allow higher throughput despite occasional NVLink hops.
maggie: I ran an A/B with 1000 req/min traffic replay. fused enabled (when affinity high) increased qps by ~9% for same 95ms SLA.
sasha: edge case: rollout across mixed fleet where some nodes have different topology (DGX vs single-host gpus). selector needs to be topology-aware.
maggie: noted. next action items:
- deepa: add affinity probe + config flag (PR)
- ryan: add simulation harness to model mixed-topology effects
- sasha: update kernel-selector doc with hybrid proposal
- maggie: run larger 24h replay and post results
ryan: timeline? 
sasha: aiming for PRs by EOD Thursday and test run Friday.
maggie: cool. thanks all. ping me if you see odd NVLink counters during tests.
